reviews.text: The entire team here is so wonderful and welcoming, it makes for an excellent experience for both pets and owners! The clinic is bright and clean, and you’re always greeted with a smile (especially from Ryan at the desk!) They have great hours with some evenings and Saturdays that help you book appointments around a work schedule. Dr Marcus is a true star! She is so kind and sweet with the animals, explains every step in easy to understand language, and helps pet parents choose what is best for their pet while keeping their wallet in mind. She is honest and I trust her completely! I was originally at another clinic that was unable to accommodate us with an urgent issue and College Street took us in even when we weren’t their patients and showed us such care that I made the switch. The best clinic I’ve been to!

Everyone at College Street AH was welcoming to us, right from when I stepped in the door. We were so happy to find and move to a private clinic amidst all the conglomerate take-overs. I feel a lot better knowing that my furry guys will be seeing this amazing staff every visit instead of a corporate locum. Really lovely admin and tech people, amazing vet, rates are fine. I feel lucky to know this clinic exists.

My cats Pickles and Monkey have been with College Street Animal Hospital since they were kittens and I have always had a wonderful experience here with all of the vets. The treatments and recommendations have transparent pricing, the vets are always eager to answer all of my questions, and they have a very genuine sense of care for my pets. They have always made time during any emergencies or health issues my cats have had. As someone else mentioned, I echo the gratitude that this clinic remains independently owned; not part of a larger vet corp. And thank you to the receptionist Ryan as well who always provided detailed information and quotes as needed.

I had a great experience here today with the receptionist! Super helpful and efficient. Also had a great experience a few weeks ago with Dr. Cohen who was very informative and had great bedside manner with my cat. Very happy being a new client so far!

College Street Animal Hospital sits just across the road from where I live with my dog, and every time we walk past he wants to go in! His love for the hospital is a reflection of how kind and caring the staff is, how attentive they are to the needs of your pet, and how welcoming they make the environment feel. The staff team is transparent about pricing, communicative, and just a joy to be around. Highly recommend :)

Finding a privately owned clinic that puts pets before profits is rare these days, so after a neighbor gave this place a glowing recommendation, I had to check it out. I’m so glad I did!
Dr. Marcus was wonderful, completely honest, transparent, and grounded. She gave a really straight forward medical advice and walked me through pricing options with total fairness, recommending only what made genuine sense for my dog’s age and health status. The checkups here feel far more thorough and professional than anywhere else I've been.
While downtown Toronto vet prices are expensive across the board, this clinic stands out by providing clear, justified estimates before doing any work, so no surprises or hidden fees. On top of that, the entire team - Ryan, Anousha, Ina, Courteney, (and my true apologies if I forgot anyone else!), treated us with incredible care. So thankful to have found a team I can actually trust and recommmend.
Lastly, running an independent clinic these days is tough, and I’m sure corporate chains are knocking on their door with huge offers. Huge respect to the owners for standing firm and staying independent! I’ll definitely keep coming back with my dogs as long as you remain locally owned and keep this amazing staff in place.

The staff at College Street Animal Hospital go above and beyond. My dog had an urgent health issue and I took a chance and walked in. Despite being a new patient at the clinic, they fit her in on the same day! Grateful to have them in my neighborhood ❤️

This place turned me and my 17 year old cat away, and took their time before helping me. The receptionist was on a personal call and when they finally told me that their one surgery room was occupied it had been 25 minutes. All they told me was that my cat was in a "concerning" state. They sent me to another emergency vet 45 minutes away. I drove with my poor innocent dying cat in 4pm Toronto traffic. When I got to the next vet, he died right in front of my eyes. My heart hurts and I will never forget that day or the clinic that turned us away. I loved him so much
Wonderful experience, they’re super helpful informative and kind.

My fur baby Bonecrusher had an incident during the night where she was limping and hiding, in visible pain and I could tell she was in serious pain, as soon as as her regular vet office opened I called to let them know I was bringing her in for her first ever emergency visit, that vet said they were booked for the next seven days and I’d have to wait.

That’s when I decided to find a new veterinary office and luckily for Bonecrusher I found College Street Animal Hospital.

They took her in within an hour of me calling them, the staff are incredibly kind, friendly and informative, the doctor was perfect. She was very gentle with my little furry friend and quickly gained her trust.

Long story short here is that Cusher is now fine, turned out to be a sprain and she’s back to her old self thanks to her new vet office at College Street Animal Hospital.
Lisa was awesome with snoop

Fantastic clinic filled with staff that truly care about their clients and furry patients. They always did an amazing job reassuring me that I was doing a great job as a pet parent and was always transparent about different treatment options. Wonderful experiences with a wonderful clinic.

All of the staff here are amazing. They were accommodating, friendly, and explained everything clearly. I am so happy I switched vets. Thank you to all of the staff, especially Dr. Norwich and Dr. Snow ❤️❤️
The staff here was very friendly and helpful. They didn't offer what I was looking for but they was able to direct me to the right place.

This wasn’t our usual vet, but we had to bring our dog here when our regular clinic couldn’t see her and she needed to be seen right away. They were able to get us in within an hour of calling, which we really appreciated.

The staff was incredibly friendly, compassionate, and made us feel comfortable despite never having been there before. They took great care of our dog and helped ease a very stressful situation. We’re very grateful for the care and kindness we received.

Thank you to the entire staff from Rebel :)
The team at College Street Animal Hospital has looked after our family's dogs and cats for over 10 years. To a person, their care, professionalism and service is excellent. Highly recommend!

In 2024 we made the decision to seek out a new veterinary clinic to take care of our furry family members. From the very first visit, where we met Anousha and Ryan, we knew we were in the right place. Our girl, Gracie, was nervous about new experiences, and these two were dedicated to making sure she felt comfortable. Shortly after we started our care with CSAH, Gracie was diagnosed with Lymphoma. Dr. Snow was amazing throughout with her thoughtful and honest approach. The end-of-life care we received with Dr. Snow and Dr. Norwich was exactly what our family needed. Our feline family members are seen by Dr. Norwich and Dr. Cohen; through kitten-care and geriatric dental surgeries, these two have gone above and beyond for us.
Billings have been transparent and are provided upfront; I've never felt surprised by an invoice.
As the practice grows and we meet new people (Ina, Monica, Michelle, Julien, Courtney, to name a few), the feeling that we're in good hands hasn't changed.
I recommend College Street Animal Hospital to everyone I can.

Dubu loves coming to this hospital and we always have a great vet experience! The staff in the front are always friendly and the doctors are fantastic, patient and very knowledgeable.

Highly recommend!

I have nothing but good things to say about this veterinary clinic.  They take incredible care of my dog and everyone always goes above and beyond to make sure everything is handled with attention and compassion.

Even though there are other clinics within walking distance of home, I gladly make the drive because I completely trust them and I know they’ll always do what’s best for my dog and me.

We generally see Dr. Snow, who has been fantastic.  However, on several occasions we have seen other vets, and they’ve all been great as well. It really speaks to the overall quality of the team. Everyone is thorough, professional, and genuinely care about your pet.

If you’re looking for a clinic you can trust to provide the best care for your pet, I highly recommend College Street Animal Hospital.
Very friendly staff! Happy to be a client!

Dr. Snow and the entire team at College Street Animal Hospital are so warm and compassionate. The space is cheery and immaculate. Every visit feels like I’m taking my cats to the spa. It is obvious that everyone is passionate about what they do. A great asset to the community. Keep up the good work!

Dr. Lisa Cohen is an exceptional vet. She truly cares, takes the time to explain everything, and makes you feel heard. The entire staff is friendly and welcoming, and their follow-up is always thoughtful and thorough. Highly recommend!

College street animal hospital has been so amazing. Reba is such a nice girl but she’s stoic and sometimes doesn’t tell us when she’s hurting until it’s urgent. They always make time to see us last minute and treat her like their very own.  Reba is no longer an anxious vet-visitor. Treatment is so thorough and you can just tell they’re going above and beyond what you normally expect at the vet. They always call to check in after treatment and see the problems through until resolved.

She has seen all the vets there and each experience has been so positive. They have such excellent client-facing care and truly invest effort to making sure the owners feel comfortable with treatment. Can’t recommend enough.
Amazing team who genuinely care about your pets. Friendly, professional, and always a great experience!

Dr. Danielle Snow saved my dogs life last year and because of her he is approaching his tenth birthday with full puppy energy. She felt a very small mass on a routine exam, but given her experience level knew to do further testing. It ended up being cancerous and she supported us in getting set up for surgery within one week of diagnosis. We are so grateful for her ongoing care and giving us more time with our dog. This type of cancer can be extremely aggressive and she caught it super early. Thank you!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!

My cat has been a patient at College Street Animal Hospital for the last 14 years, and we (speaking for her) have had only had positive experiences. The doctors, techs and staff are uniformly caring and kind, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the clinic to anyone.

From our very first visit, my dog Sultan and I realized the CSAH surpassed another clinic in the Annex where I used to bring him.
The receptionist is courteous, competent, efficient, responsive, friendly to my dog, and offered him a permitted treat.
The technician is very welcoming and approached Sultan very gently. As did the Doctor who put him at ease using patience and gentle consensual handling, demonstrating her care and experience with animals: earning Sultan’s trust was her goal. The Doctor explained what needed to be done and the follow-up. This resulted in Sultan cooperating fully with his new good Doctor for his examination and inoculation. Sultan and I left very very pleased and totally confident in CSAH’s ability to deal with an excitable four-legged companion, and at reasonable fees.

2025 November
The above review dates back a year ago. So a year later, my dog enjoys the same care and attention and their standards remain as high as a year ago. They keep track and inform me of needed vaccination and exams. The personnel is most accommodating and helpful. Five stars!

April 2026
CSAH consistently operates not as a business but as a professional care facility for my dog who always comes out pleased with his visit. The veterinarians and technicians alike provide the special attention he requires, and I find them and the receptionists respectful and considerate of the client. They exceed my expectations.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review. We're glad you had a great experience with us!
Amazing customer service and care! My pup is def in the best hands!

I can’t say enough great things about this vet clinic. From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm, professional, and genuinely caring. They took the time to thoroughly explain everything, answered all of my questions without rushing, and made sure my pet felt as comfortable as possible throughout the visit.

The clinic itself is clean, organized, and clearly well-run. You can tell the team truly cares about the animals they treat and the families who love them. I especially appreciated how transparent they were about treatment options and pricing — no surprises, just honest and thoughtful care.

If you’re looking for a veterinary clinic that combines expertise with compassion, I highly recommend them. My pet is in great hands here, and that peace of mind is priceless.

Levi (Yorkiepoo) and I enjoyed our wellness visit today. Dr. Snow and her team were very attentive to Levi. Dr. Snow answered all my questions and gave us helpful information and tips. Levi was super chill during his appointment. Thank you
The vets and staff here are so nice and friendly. Our dog and cat both love visiting this place!
Professional, quick service. Charlie has no qualms about visiting

Took my dog in for first time and Dr. Snow was very patient, thorough and understanding. Her advice was great and I like the honesty .  I'm so happy the clinic relocated just steps from my home, making vet visits so convenient .  Looking forward to our next visit .

My dog Cocolina was a patient at College Street Animal Hospital, and she was always treated with incredible care and compassion. Unfortunately, Cocolina was diagnosed with terminal cancer, and it was first seen on her X rays. Dr. Cohen personally called the oncologist so Cocolina could be seen as quickly as possible. Sadly, the cancer had already metastasized to her lungs and several other organs 💔. We were able to get an appointment within two days, which is almost unheard of, as oncologists are very hard to book. Thanks to Dr. Cohen, my Cocolina was seen early and with urgency.

On her very last day, Dr. Cohen was truly extraordinary. Her empathy, calm presence, and professionalism during the hardest moment of my life meant more than I can put into words.

Dr. Cohen made sure Cocolina was comfortable, respected, and surrounded by love until the very end. I will forever be grateful for the care and dignity she gave her and for how gently she guided me through saying goodbye.

Every staff member was kind and understanding, even when I returned to pick up her ashes. I cannot recommend this clinic enough, and I cannot recommend Dr. Cohen enough.

Dr. Cohen, thank you for giving my Cocolina such a beautiful, loving goodbye. You
are an angel on earth.

Had another great vet experience! All the staff from reception to the doctors are amazing and caring, and explain everything super well. Dr. Lisa Cohen has seen us through a number of issues over the years from GI distress to behavioral challenges, and has always been kind and knowledgeable on every visit.

Highly recommend this team!

We recently moved to Toronto and College St Animal Hospital has already guided us through a cat's urinary issue, last minute realization that we needed travel papwrwork, and most sadly an unexpected cancer diagnosis in our dog. Throughout they were incredibly compassionate, competent and communicative, and have showed true care for us as people and our furry family members. Can't recommend them highly enough!
Thanks so much for the review!

🐾♡ Truly exceptional care from start to finish! I brought my young Shiba inu to College Street Animal Hospital for the first time after deciding to switch vets, and I couldn’t be happier with the change.  My dog has quite a bit of anxiety at the vet, but Dr. Cohen and the entire team welcomed her with such warmth, patience, and genuine care. They completely understood her needs, handled her with love, and even won her over with treats.. she truly had a great time! Their professionalism exceeded all our expectations, and the thoughtful follow-up after the appointment shows just how committed they are to their patients. We’re so grateful to have found this clinic. Highly recommend! (づ｡◕‿‿◕｡)づ

I'd recommend College Street Animal Hospital! My puppy, Enzo, is a new patient, and we've been in for a couple of visits so far. Dr. Michelle Marcus, the front desk team, and the rest of the staff have been super friendly and incredibly helpful in answering our many questions. The team is also very caring - after the first round of vaccines, our puppy had a symptom we weren't sure of (turned out to be unrelated), so we called in and they were happy to talk it through with us over the phone. They then called back the next day to check in on how he was doing. Small, thoughtful things like this are really appreciated as new puppy owners!

I felt very unheard the last time I came to visit with my anxious cat. They ran unecessary tests, making me believe her anxiety was kidney disease when I advocated it was not. They did not listen to me, explaining it was kidney disease. She’s 3. And had a new stressor enter and did not have any symptoms before this. They had me run all these tests that all came out normal just as I told them it would. I switched vets and they provided her with better care.

I have met many vets in my life as a keeper of four leggeds, and on this journey met Lisa Cohen and followed her when she opened her clinic with Danielle Snow. We consider ourselves very fortunate to have this clinic in our neighbourhood. They have provided thorough, compassionate care for our dogs and cat. Ryan and Anousha are equally lovely and human as admin staff. Highly recommend these two lovely women and their clinic

We’ve been clients since the clinic first opened, and I can’t say enough good things about the team! They’ve always provided excellent, compassionate care for our cat and have gone above and beyond to accommodate us whenever we needed a last-minute appointment or had a concern. Everyone, from the front desk to the vets themselves, takes the time to listen and make sure we feel comfortable and our cat is cared for. It’s clear they genuinely love what they do. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a team that truly puts animals first!

Coming in to the College Street Animal Hospital as a new client, I was warmly welcomed by the staff. They answered all my questions and made me and my kitty feel comfortable. Dr. Cohen is super nice and very caring!! I'm super happy I made this switch!

I didn't feel like I was heard when I took my elderly cat in, and it felt like I was being upsold on treatment that wouldn't help her. I've since moved to another vet but I thought I'd share my experiences.
Highly recommend this clinic! Have taken my dog here a few times and always had a great experience. Your pets will be in good hands here.

This is by far the best animal hospital I’ve ever been to. The staff are incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and truly care about every pet that walks through their doors. They always take the time to explain things clearly and make sure both you and your pet feel comfortable. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dog — they’re simply the best!

Hi Yael. We tried to find your name in our client roster to reach out directly, but it seems you are not registered with our clinic. We would love a chance to connect and see how we could improve a future experience.

I recently moved to College St Animal Hospital and could not be happier with the staff and services my pups received! The staff are all friendly and knowledgeable, clear about specifics for my dog’s care, along with being transparent about costs. I also love that they are independently owned.
Thank you for your 4-star review! If there’s anything we can do to make your next visit even better, we’d love to hear your feedback.

I’m so grateful for College Street Animal Hospital. All of the vets have been incredible with my high-needs dog - patient, gentle, and always take the time to explain things so I feel comfortable with his care. The staff are kind and welcoming, appointments run on time, and they even check in after visits. It’s such a relief knowing my dog is cared for by people I can truly trust.

This is the worst clinic I have ever been to. I have been going there for 7 years since my dog was born and I informed them I would be arriving 10 min late and needed to park. They said if I don’t get there before the 10 min that falls outside their cancelation period and would be charged $50.00 the receptionist is rude and they have zero flexibility. I then made it only 6 min late when they knew I was on my way and gave my appointment to someone else forcing me to wait 30 min to the next time slot. They had no right to do so given I told them I was on my way and would make it after they refused to give me a 1-2 min grace period in the event I went over for parking. AWFUL AWFUL

Great service and wonderful care for my cats! They do not run up unnecessary charges or procedures on your bill. They give you all the options and have great follow up. The team makes you feel like they truly have your pet's best interest at heart!

After finding College Street Animal Hospital, we couldn’t imagine taking our feline family members anywhere else. After years of ineffective treatment at other animal hospitals, the team at College Street managed to help us finally get our cat’s fairly serious health condition under control (to the extent that such a thing was possible). Their expertise and commitment to providing the best possible care made a huge difference in his life (and ours), and as he got older and new health concerns arose, we always knew that the team would be honest with us about what was realistic, and what would (or would not) help to maintain his quality of life. They always took the time to thoroughly explain whatever course of action they were recommending, were very patient with our questions, and never once made us feel like we were being nudged to do anything that wasn’t absolutely necessary.

For assorted reasons, our cat was cared for by multiple vets during his time as a patient at College Street (his condition requiring urgent appointments that couldn’t wait for a specific vet to be available being a big one), and we would recommend any of them without hesitation. We also can't say enough good things about the front office staff, whose knowledge, responsiveness and warmth also exceeded expectations.

The provision of care is about more than just procedures and medications, of course, and this is where College Street really set themselves apart for us. At 18 ½, our cat began to rapidly decline and the team at College Street could not have been more compassionate. These people care. An unbelievable amount. On our final visit we felt more like we were commiserating with family who were almost as invested in his little life as we had been, and it’s impossible to say enough about what a huge difference this made at a time that was incredibly difficult.

After many months, we finally felt ready to welcome a new family member and it should tell you something that one of the things we were most excited about was getting to take her to College Street Animal Hospital and show her off to everyone there. We genuinely missed the entire team (we’d spent a lot of time there in our little guy’s final years), and they did not disappoint when we brought our new kitten in for her first appointment. We have so much peace of mind now, knowing that she’s going to get the best possible care from the very best team, from the very start of her life.
The team at college street animal hospital has taken very good care of my senior diabetic cat.  They are very responsive and friendly too. Highly recommend.

College Street Animal Hospital has always provide for my cats, both at routine visits and in emergencies. Everyone at the clinic, the veterinarians, the vet techs, and assistants, and the reception staff, is unfailingly professional, helpful, and willing to go the extra mile to ensure that we are all on the same page. I cannot  recommend them highly enough.
Thank you for your review!

My partner and I are happy to sing the praises of this excellent clinic! Our cat has not had any health crises but the routine care has been outstanding, including clear feedback and sensitive handling of our very shy cat, Pepper. She had gained too much weight in the care of a previous vet and was put on a new diet with complimentary monthly weigh-ins which I’m happy to say was a total success! The team of doctors, technicians and administrative staff all create a very welcoming atmosphere, with special mention of Ryan who clearly loves animals and is unfailingly helpful whenever we call. We have had 5 cats over several decades and this clinic is by far our all time favourite!
Thanks so much for the review, Wenkun!
College Street Animal Hospital is the best in Toronto. The level of care is extraordinary and bringing my 2 pups there is always a wonderful experience. Dr Snow & her team are so kind & caring.

My experience  with College Street Animal Hospital has always been great. Moving away and coming back 4 years later . We had a new vet . She is knowledgeable and caring. 2 qualities you definitely need in any doctor. Very happy with our experience.  I recommend them highly.😺 …
Thank you for your review!

Excellent care team for your pet! Booking by phone is always quick and easy with good availability. Appointments are always on time. Procedures and fees are discussed openly and honestly. Everyone from the front desk staff, to the techs, to the vets are kind and professional. My cat sees Dr. Norwich and it’s very evident how much she cares about her patients.
I wanted to say the staff there are amazing compassion best vet I've ever been too. Thank you for taking care of Freddie my ♥ is greatfull for all u did .from the bottom of my heart thank you ♥

We love College Street Animal hospital. My pup Morty loves the friendly staff and pulls me in to say hi a few times a week. He’s had great care both when he’s perfectly healthy and through his surgery.

It’s typically not a good “reason” to visit a vet but CSAH has been our neighbourhood go-to for many years for our kitties. Dr. Michelle is empathetic and caring and their admin team make an effort to check up on your fur-children.
Thanks so much for the review!
Staff is very friendly, always helpful and kind. Vets are caring and gentle with pets. Vet care is expensive but I feel like they are comprehensive and offer options. I would recommend this clinic.

These guys are 10/10 service and friendliness. They really care for the pets and take the time to get to know them. They make every effort to get the help needed and are upfront about price without any pressure.
